title: Geriye 3
subtitle: 1. Kana Asur
paragraphsAbove: Alifatoju higulu ŋaduk kin̰e. Laakin terek, un ŋaduk un kanakiŋin kakarayin̰e. Iŋi guneye, iŋ kitabta, alifatojuŋu ŋadukuŋ kenekmense kiŋiniyoto. Wey alifatojuŋu kanakiŋ kenekse kiŋiniye.
paragraphsBelow: Kiligit unor, iŋ alifatatiri garta jikin. Iŋ alifatatir lakgo jarnigo egeriyo jan. 'iiiiiiiii'. Iŋ hal, egeriyo jan.

subtitle: 4. Kana Asur Ereba Geriyo
paragraphsAbove: Iŋ alifatatir kanar 'l' eney. Kilme 'liil' an haraka eenekir.
paragraphsBelow: Kiligit unor, iŋ alifatatiri garta jikin. Iŋ alifatatir lakgo jarnigo egeriyo jan. 'llllllllll'. Iŋ hal, egeriyo jan.
